div.div:
Legend & settings
Dark blue = 1 Gb/s backbone · grey = original 100 Mb/s point-to-point catalog links · purple = 10BASE-T1S multidrop (PLCA, max_bc 0, to_timer 32 bit)
Yellow = new T1S nodes (all traffic PCP 7 = highest catalog class, shared with brake F08–F10) · red = WINDOW1/3 (catalog flow F15/F17, PCP 3) · dashed red = cross-bus request/response
Scheduling: sensor/ECU releases at fixed offsets inside each 1 ms (cross-bus flows first) · clocks drift U(−50, 50) ppm, gPTP Sync 125 ms, Pdelay 1 s · T1S nodes use their zonal switch clock
Same-bus loops: ECM↔ETC 1 ms, MAP→ECM 1 ms, LAMBDA→ECM 10 ms, GEAR/OSS→TCU 10 ms · EV variant: bus A = VCU, INVF, DCDC, TMS; bus B = BMS, INVR, OBC, USS
